# BookOrbit, Prateek's fork

A downstream fork of [BookOrbit](https://github.com/bookorbit/bookorbit), the self-hosted library and reading platform. It carries Prateek's changes on top of upstream releases; changes that would help every BookOrbit user are candidates to send upstream.

- [FORK.md](https://github.com/prateek/bookorbit/blob/downstream/FORK.md): how the fork is maintained
- [BookOrbit's README](https://github.com/prateek/bookorbit/blob/downstream/README.md): features, installation, and development
- Images: `ghcr.io/prateek/bookorbit:<upstream-version>-prateek.<n>`, built from release tags
